$comment: Test tiers for this repo, read by an external, project-agnostic tier runner that mounts the repo root at /code in throwaway containers. light: the web app's svelte-check (npm ci with --ignore-scripts, so no dependency install script runs), then dotnet test for both test projects. Both steps copy what they need to /tmp first, so bin/, obj/, node_modules and anything an install script writes never land in the working tree. Both steps need network access for npm ci and dotnet restore. No services: the tests mock the Immich API. Lint (prettier, eslint) is left out: the upstream tree is not lint-clean and its CI does not enforce it.

light.run: set -e; mkdir -p /tmp/src; tar -C /code --exclude=./.git --exclude=./.claude --exclude=./.scratch --exclude='./immichFrame.Web/node_modules' --exclude='./docs/node_modules' --exclude='*/bin' --exclude='*/obj' -cf - . | tar -C /tmp/src -xf -; cd /tmp/src; dotnet test ImmichFrame.Core.Tests/ImmichFrame.Core.Tests.csproj; dotnet test ImmichFrame.WebApi.Tests/ImmichFrame.WebApi.Tests.csproj

extra.run: set -e; export npm_config_cache=/tmp/npm-cache npm_config_update_notifier=false CI=true NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=1024; mkdir -p /tmp/web; tar -C /code/immichFrame.Web --exclude=./node_modules --exclude=./.svelte-kit -cf - . | tar -C /tmp/web -xf -; cd /tmp/web; npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund; npm run check
